intro: The passive with ser, the passive with se, and the difference between fue cerrado and está cerrado.

bloques.texto:
**Ser + participle** is the full passive. The participle agrees with the subject, and **por** brings in the doer: la novela **fue escrita por** Cervantes. Los guías **han sido contratados**. It belongs mostly to the press, history and formal writing.

**Se + verb** is the passive people use every day. It has no doer: **se construyó** en 1900; **se vendieron** todas las entradas.

In speech, the object can simply go first, with a pronoun to repeat it: el puente **lo construyeron** los romanos.

**Estar + participle** is not an action. It is the state that results: la tienda **fue cerrada** a las ocho (someone closed it); la tienda **está cerrada** (that is how it is now).

The person who receives something cannot be a passive subject. I was given a book is **me dieron** un libro.

filas: El puente fue construido por los romanos.
El puente se construyó en el siglo I.
El puente lo construyeron los romanos.

frases.es: El cuadro fue restaurado en el museo el año pasado.
frases.en: The painting was restored at the museum last year.

frases.es: Había sido pintado por Goya en 1800.
frases.en: It had been painted by Goya in 1800.

frases.es: Ayer se encontró en un piso de las afueras.
frases.en: Yesterday it was found in a flat on the outskirts.
analisis: en un piso de las afueras

frases.es: Dos personas han sido contratadas por la empresa.
frases.en: Two people have been hired by the company.

frases.es: El museo está cerrado, pero volverá a abrir el viernes.
frases.en: The museum is closed, but it will reopen on Friday.

bloques.pregunta: Complete: the novel was written by Cervantes.

opciones.escrita: The participle agrees with la novela.
opciones.escribida: The participle of escribir is irregular: escrito.

bloques.pregunta: Complete: the guides have been hired.

opciones.sido: The passive is built with ser: han sido.
opciones.estado: Han estado contratados describes a state, not the hiring.
opciones.ser: After han you need the participle sido.

bloques.pregunta: Complete, with se: all the tickets were sold.

opciones.vendieron: The verb agrees with las entradas.
opciones.vendidas: After se you need a conjugated verb.

opciones.the state the shop is in now: Estar plus participle is a result.

bloques.correcta: the state the shop is in now

bloques.pregunta: How does Spanish say «I was given a book»?

opciones.Me dieron un libro: The receiver cannot be a passive subject.
opciones.Fui dado un libro: Spanish does not make the receiver the subject.
opciones.Soy dado un libro: Spanish does not make the receiver the subject.

bloques.frase: Dos personas han sido contratadas por la empresa
bloques.traduccion: Two people have been hired by the company.

**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a short encyclopedia entry about a building, an invention or a work of art, using the passive.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Tell the news aloud as a presenter would: three events in the passive.
